summary: James has called himself a 'staunch supporter of Israel,' introduced HR 7633 to expand U.S. security cooperation with Israel and Middle East partners, and co-signed a letter urging DOJ to investigate Al-Quds Day rally organizers in Dearborn. His conflict framing is binary—'Israel is our ally. Iran is our enemy'—centered on eliminating Hamas and Iranian proxies. He also voted for and sponsored the Antisemitism Awareness Act incorporating the IHRA definition, and Vote for Peace opposes him.
